criteria.supports: The excerpt asserts, from its own evidence, that the claim holds: an independent verification step exists and is separate from the producing component.
criteria.contradicts: The excerpt asserts, from its own evidence, that the claim does not hold: verification is absent, or is performed by the same component that produced the output.
criteria.qualifies: The excerpt narrows the claim's scope or states a condition under which it holds, without either asserting or denying it in general.
criteria.contextualizes: The excerpt bears on the subject matter but takes no position on the claim: background, definition, or a related measurement.

label_provenance.account: NOT A GOLD STANDARD. Twenty invented excerpts written to exercise the measurement apparatus of task-packets/N1-T02.yaml: no real source, no real author, no DOI, nothing retrievable. Its class distribution is fixed to reproduce that packet's hand-computed acceptance oracle (AT1). The real standard is set by an encounter with another practice (owner decision 2026-08-01) and will arrive as its own file.

notes: Distribution: supports 10, contradicts 5, qualifies 3, contextualizes 2. Scored against fixtures/mb-cls-v1.synthetic.predictions.json it yields the confusion matrix [[8,1,1,0],[1,3,1,0],[1,0,2,0],[1,0,0,1]], accuracy 0.70, majority baseline 0.50, Cohen's kappa exactly 17/32, false-support rate 0.30. Every category is below power; that is the point of the flag, not a defect of the fixture.
